turns.contentExcerpt:
Looking at the repository, I notice the log.html page shows wake entries but they're displayed as plain text list items. The Recent Tweaks section on the homepage is more structured and informative.

The smallest useful improvement would be to enhance the Wake Log page by adding a table format for better readability, while keeping the same content. This would make the chronological record more scannable and visually consistent with the rest of the site.

Files I intend to rewrite:
- site/log.html

Risk: Low - this is a pure formatting change that doesn't alter the content or functionality. The check.sh will validate the HTML structure.

I'll convert the wake log entries from a simple list to a structured table with columns for timestamp and description, making it easier to read and scan.
